title: Five AI Tools That Can Help You Deliver Paid Work

scenes.narration: Five AI tools can support useful client deliverables. This is a map of potential workflows, not a money claim.
scenes.source: Creator-made title slide only; label potential workflows and show no money figures.

scenes.narration: Tools can reduce production time, but choosing a real problem, earning trust, and delivering quality remain human work.
scenes.source: Record a real local browser session with five tool tabs; no private account data.

scenes.narration: Choose one useful deliverable, make a transparent sample, offer it to a defined buyer, and improve it with feedback.
scenes.source: Creator-made disclosure slide; no dashboard or revenue claim.

scenes.narration: We will cover edited writing, social content, disclosed narration, digital-product concepts, and sourced research briefs.
scenes.source: Creator-made overview; tool names checked against current official sites before recording.

scenes.narration: For writing, begin with an approved brief and source material; never ask a model to invent client facts.
scenes.source: Record a permitted ChatGPT session using fictional or creator-owned source text.

scenes.narration: Request an outline first, flag missing information, then draft in sections after the facts are approved.
scenes.source: Record actual prompt/output; redact account details; show do not invent facts instruction.

scenes.narration: The deliverable needs human editing: check facts, claims, links, accessibility, and any qualified-review requirements.
scenes.source: Creator-made checklist based on the narration.

scenes.narration: A clearly labeled mock offer can explain scope and revision policy without implying a job, client, invoice, or listing.
scenes.source: Clearly labeled mock offer; never a job, client, invoice, or platform listing.

scenes.narration: For social content, collect a mini brand kit before designing, or use a neutral practice project instead.
scenes.source: Record a permitted Canva session with fictional/sample brand assets or written permission.

scenes.narration: Build a consistent template system, use approved facts and assets, and check contrast, crops, spelling, and readability.
scenes.source: Record actual build process using licensed/owned assets; no fabricated testimonials.

scenes.narration: A package can define concepts, revisions, files, and optional scheduling without promising growth, sales, or virality.
scenes.source: Creator-made example scope/disclosure slide; no growth or sales promises.

scenes.narration: Synthetic narration is for appropriate work: confirm the script owner, permitted use, voice authorization, and current license.
scenes.source: Record permitted account with creator-owned script and authorized voice; verify current license.

scenes.narration: Do not clone without documented consent, portray synthetic audio as human, or imply public-figure endorsement.
scenes.source: Creator-made consent/disclosure checklist.

scenes.narration: Generate short sections, check names and pacing, then deliver a clearly labeled sample made from a self-written script.
scenes.source: Produce waveform/video from self-written, labeled AI sample; no impersonation.

scenes.narration: For original digital-product concepts, use a specific audience and style direction without artist, brand, character, or franchise references.
scenes.source: Record permitted Midjourney session; prompt avoids artist, brand, character, or franchise references.

scenes.narration: Curate a creator-generated collection and retain its generation record while checking commercial-use terms and licenses.
scenes.source: Use only creator-generated collection; retain generation/source record and license checks.

scenes.narration: Before listing, verify dimensions, resolution, color, cropping, marketplace rules, and any required AI disclosure.
scenes.source: Creator-made terms, marketplace policy, file-quality, and disclosure checklist.

scenes.narration: For research, start with a narrow question and request a plan plus a list of claims that need source links.
scenes.source: Record permitted Gemini session using fictional brief; never show unverified output as fact.

scenes.narration: A research table is only useful when every important fact has a real, reviewable URL and access date.
scenes.source: Clearly labeled example table; sources must be real, reviewable URLs with access dates.

scenes.narration: AI output is not verified research. Check primary sources, state limitations, and seek qualified advice for consequential decisions.
scenes.source: Creator-made limitations/source-check slide.

scenes.narration: Choose one lane, make an honest sample, ask for feedback, and track time, replies, revisions, costs, and substantiated results.
scenes.source: Creator-made action plan; no earnings claims or projections.

scenes.narration: Sell a clear outcome, disclose relevant AI use, and improve the final result beyond the first generation.
scenes.source: Record creator-owned channel outro; disclose affiliate links in description if any.
